title: Design System: Town of Newcastle Applicant Portal

large-title.purpose: The project's title on its dashboard; the You and Messages headings.

confirm-value.purpose: The Town's map value on an "Is this right?" card; tabular numerals.

title.purpose: "Town of Newcastle — Permits" under the seal on Home; outer property-page headings (Where, Is this your property?).

question.purpose: The question in every card body (including the start cards), Check your email, result lines; at most 30ch, balanced.

body.purpose: The phone bar's ‹ Project; the project-name field while renaming; results prose.

body-compact.purpose: Card buttons, fields, sidebar items, dashboard and Home row names, the parcel's Map and Lot (600), permit names (600), errors.

row.purpose: Tile and add-tile labels, list rows, reviews in What you'll need, item rows, set short names, check-page questions and answers.

footnote.purpose: Card header, box headings in their own case, box footnotes, lot lines, fees, reviewers and clocks, Change/Finish/Remove, save status.

group-header.purpose: Uppercase heading above an inset group on the outer property pages only.

caption.purpose: Status pills, a part's one-line summary, a field's name on You, the form's term on Check and send.

tab-label.purpose: The four labels in the phone's bottom tab bar, under 22px icons.

shadows.name: slider-knob
shadows.purpose: The iOS slider knob only; containers take no shadow.

shadows.name: button-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on card buttons; a ring, not elevation.

motion.name: pane-push
motion.value: 300ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1), translateX(24%) and opacity 0 to rest
motion.purpose: The next card's body sliding in; the card's edge, header and footer stay still.

motion.name: pane-pull
motion.value: 300ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1), translateX(-24%) and opacity 0 to rest
motion.purpose: Back: the previous card's body sliding in from the left.

motion.name: tile-answer-delay
motion.purpose: Pause after a tile tap so the choice is seen before the next card.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar window and the dashboard's 280px side column at and above; tab bar below.

blur.name: phone-bars
blur.purpose: The phone's 44px bar in a card and its bottom tab bar, over scrolling content.

icons.size: 18px (16px inside card buttons, 22px in the tab bar)

rulings: --app-edge is #8E8E93 light / #6C6C70 dark (3:1 on the row); the brief's §4.8 gave #AEAEB2 / #545458.
Fields are 44px tall for touch; the brief's §4.5 gave 36px.
No check mark on a chosen multi-choice tile; the 1.5px label edge alone shows it.
The roof's slope appears under its own small footnote question once the roof style is chosen.
codeBriefDisagreements: Where.tsx ('Where is the property?', 'Is this your property?') still sets its question at 22px/600 and uses HeroUI's Card and teal primary buttons; brief §9 puts these in the same card as 'Do I need a permit?' at 20px.
Card buttons (Back, Continue, stepper) are 36px tall per brief §4.6, under the 44px touch minimum the fields were raised to.
notCanonized: The phone bar's back mark is a typed '‹' character at 22px, not a Tabler chevron-left; recorded as built, not as a rule for new surfaces.

narrative.northStar: The Settings Pane, a Task at a Time
narrative.overview:
The portal is Apple's System Settings and iOS Settings applied to a Town permit. An application is a **project**: a lot and the parts of the work on it (a new building, an addition, a driveway, ...). The project's home is a dashboard: its title and a status pill, the parcel, a row per part with its status pill, tiles for the parts still to add, and beside them what the project will need, who is applying, and Check and send. Opening a part opens a card: a contained white panel on the grouped ground with three bands, a header that names the part and shows a thin segmented progress bar, a body that asks one question (or one small set of values), and a footer with Back on the left and the card's one filled button on the right. Only the body moves between questions; the card's edge, header and footer stay still. The dashboard is the recap: there is no long review page.

The window holds four places, Home, Project, Messages and You: a 250 px sidebar under the Town seal on a desktop, a bottom tab bar on a phone. The world is quiet and native. Type is the device's own system face; colour is Apple's system greys and grouped grounds; the only hue is the Town seal's teal, used for links, the current tab, the in-progress pill, focus rings and the seal itself, not for buttons. The card's primary action is near-black (near-white in dark mode). Done is a soft green pill; things still left are a soft amber pill. Light and dark follow the device (`main.tsx` sets `data-theme`; a `prefers-color-scheme` media query covers first paint). Native grammar is used without imitating native chrome: no fake window controls, traffic lights or status bars. Icons are Tabler outline icons, 18 px at stroke 1.75, never filled and never emoji.

The answer trail of chips, the page dots, the full-width question screens, the fixed footer action bar, the large-title navigation bar, the step sidebar with drawn glyphs, the teal Continue pill, the desktop toolbar, the task list and Save and close are gone.
keyCharacteristics: A project is a dashboard of parts; each part is a run of cards; Check and send is one tap from the dashboard.
One contained card at a time: 640 px (760 px for the lot drawing and compass), 12 px corners, a 0.5 px hairline, no shadow.
Progress is a 3 px segmented bar in the card header with "3 of 6"; status is a pill on the part's row.
Lists are boxes: a 13px heading in its own case above a 12 px-cornered row-coloured box, rows under hairlines.
Tiles are outlined, not filled; chosen is a 1.5 px label-coloured edge.
One filled button per card or page, in the label colour; teal is for words, the current tab, the in-progress pill and focus.
Depth by tone and hairline, not shadow.

rules.name: The Teal Is for Words Rule
rules.body: Teal appears only as text and line icons (links, Change, ‹ Project, the current tab), the in-progress pill and the focus ring. The one filled button is the label colour, never teal.

rules.name: The Two Teals Rule
rules.body: Teal that carries text is accent-text (lifted in dark); the seal's own teal marks identity and never carries text.

rules.name: The Edge Not Block Rule
rules.body: Choice is shown by an edge, never a solid fill: a chosen tile thickens to a 1.5 px label edge with no fill; the older segments and chips add the selection wash under an accent edge.

rules.name: The One Tone per Meaning Rule
rules.body: Each pill tone says one thing: green is finished (Done, Ready to send, Decided), wash is under way (2 of 4, Sent, With the Town), fill is not begun (Not started, Draft), amber is things left. No other surface takes the green or the amber.

rules.name: The System Face Rule
rules.body: Text is set in the device's system face at the ramp's sizes (30 / 22 / 20 / 17 / 15 / 14 / 13 / 12, and 11 for the tab bar alone); no other family is loaded and no other size is used.

rules.name: The One Question Rule
rules.body: A card body carries one Question line; help is one footnote line 4 px under it and 16 px above the control (its space held when empty so the control does not jump).

rules.name: The Tone Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Containers never take a drop shadow; depth comes from ground, row, elevated row and the hairline.

dos: **Do** put every question in a card: header with bar and count, body with one question, footer with Back and at most one filled button.
**Do** let a single choice answer at a tap and move on after 200 ms; give Continue only to what a tap cannot finish.
**Do** show progress with the card header's segmented bar and a part's or project's status with its pill, one tone per meaning.
**Do** put lists outside a card in boxes: a 13px heading in its own case, a 12 px-cornered row-coloured box, hairline rows.
**Do** draw icons from the pinned Tabler outline set at 18 px, stroke 1.75 (22 px in the tab bar); give a question's tiles icons on every option or none.
**Do** keep fields, sidebar items and every link action at 44 px; tiles, add tiles and list rows at 48 px; dashboard and project rows at 56 px.
**Do** use the `--app-*` variables (or HeroUI's variables mapped onto them), never literal hex, so light, dark and sheet elevation all follow.
**Do** keep Home, Project, Messages and You in the sidebar at 1024 px and up and in the bottom tab bar below; a card on a phone gets ‹ Project.
donts: **Don't** bring back the answer trail, page dots, a footer action bar, a large-title navigation bar inside a card, the task list or a long review page; the dashboard is the recap.
**Don't** fill a card's button with teal; the filled button is the label colour.
**Don't** fill a chosen tile; show it with the 1.5 px label edge.
**Don't** use the done green or warning amber outside a pill.
**Don't** imitate native window chrome: no traffic lights, fake status bars or title-bar controls.
**Don't** drop-shadow a container; raise a sheet by tone.
**Don't** set text in the seal teal; text teal is accent-text.
**Don't** use filled icons, emoji or hand-drawn paths for icons (roof silhouettes and the two diagrams excepted).
**Don't** load a web font or display face, or set a size off the ramp.
